criterion: Sum over groups of the support-query gradient product divided by group size. Use positive input partitions and keep the latent rank per neuron fixed.

classification.validation: Tune on the original development episodes, maximizing accuracy then minimizing NLL. Include the original 25/75/150/300 Adam-step grid and rates .003/.01 for all fresh fits.
classification.test: Reuse the prior episode inputs and labels exactly. Forecasts fixed before the new query metrics. Primary is five examples per class; report both versions of the Aug-Omniglot queries.
